CREATE TABLE "mytour"."Account" (
  "access_token" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" int4,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "id_token" text,
  "oauth_token" text,
  "oauth_token_secret" text,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerAccountId" text NOT NULL,
  "refresh_token" text,
  "scope" text,
  "session_state" text,
  "token_type" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "mytour"."AuditLog" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "targetId" text NOT NULL,
  "targetType" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "mytour"."AvailabilityBlock" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "endsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "listingId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "startsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "mytour"."Booking" (
  "advanceAmount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "approvedAt" timestamptz,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "checkIn" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "checkOut" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "declineReason" text,
  "declinedAt" timestamptz,
  "discountAmount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "listingId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "monthlyRentSnapshot" int4 NOT NULL,
  "renterId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "renterNote" text,
  "serviceChargeAmount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_status_check_cd3064cb" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'DECLINED', 'CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "mytour"."Favorite" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "listingId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "userId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "mytour"."Listing" (
  "addressNote" text,
  "advanceAmount" int4,
  "amenities" text[] NOT NULL,
  "area" text NOT NULL,
  "availableFrom" timestamptz,
  "availableTo" timestamptz,
  "bathrooms" int4 NOT NULL,
  "bedrooms" int4 NOT NULL,
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "furnished" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "houseRules" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "monthlyRent" int4 NOT NULL,
  "ownerId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "propertyType" text NOT NULL,
  "serviceChargeNote" text,
  "sizeSqft" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Listing_amenities_elem_not_null_8aca8596" CHECK (array_position("amenities", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "Listing_propertyType_check_64a3c017" CHECK ("propertyType" IN ('APARTMENT', 'HOUSE', 'ROOM', 'VILLA', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "Listing_status_check_962311ea" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'UNPUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "mytour"."ListingPhoto" (
  "caption" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "listingId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "mytour"."ListingReport" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "listingId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "reporterId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "resolutionNote" text,
  "resolvedAt" timestamptz,
  "resolvedById" character(36),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ListingReport_status_check_029bb120" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'REVIEWED', 'DISMISSED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "mytour"."Review" (
  "bookingId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "comment" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "rating" int4 NOT NULL,
  "revieweeId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "reviewerId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "mytour"."Session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "expires" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "sessionToken" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "mytour"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerified" timestamptz,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "isAdmin" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "isSuspended" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "passwordHash" text,
  "phone" text,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'RENTER' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "User_role_check_e7d7f8cc" CHECK ("role" IN ('RENTER', 'OWNER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "mytour"."VerificationToken" (
  "expires" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
